headline.title: Binance loses about $6.3 billion in 20 minutes and freezes withdrawals
headline.quip: The largest crypto theft on record began, says Binance, with a fake job interview. Decentralized finance, centrally compromised.
headline.summary: Attackers took about $6.3 billion from Binance across 10 blockchains in about 20 minutes, the largest crypto theft on record. Binance suspended withdrawals, and Tether and Circle froze about $3 billion in stablecoins; withdrawals resumed on November 1. Binance blamed an engineer infected through a fake job interview and an internal AI tool abused to reach a deployment token. The FBI attributed the hack to North Korea’s TraderTraitor.
